system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you fail a saving throw that would both deal damage and inflict a condition, you can spend 1 Superiority Die, adding the result to your save. If this would cause you to instead succeed, you release a surge of chakra with enough pressure to overtake anyone near you. On a success, all hostile creatures within 20 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your Jutsu save DC. On a failure, they become Dazed until the beginning of your next turn.

roll.note: Add the die to your failed save; if you now succeed, hostiles within 20 ft make a Wisdom save or are Dazed.
